invariants.rationale: The method immediately dereferences element, such as element.getName(), so element must not be null.
The map parameter is used without null checks, e.g. map.getTileSets(), so it must not be null.
element.getName() is used in equals comparison right at method start.
Immediately after confirming element.getName().equals("Layer"), the method gets Dimensions child and uses it, so must not be null for valid Layer input.
The method immediately calls map.getTileSets() and later uses its method getTileSet(...), so the result must not be null.
